 Shoffner crushes Cotton in 3Q fundraising 
 by 
 Matt Campbell 
 October 21, 2026 11:57 am October 21, 2026 12:20 pm

 For the second time in as many reports, Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Hallie Shoffner has outraised her opponent, Sen. Tom Cotton . 
 “Outraised” is a bit of an understatement, in fact. Unlike the slim margin she held in second-quarter money, Shoffner’s third-quarter fundraising haul was nearly triple what Cotton reported bringing in. 
 According to her Federal Election Commission filings, Shoffner raised just over $1.4 million between July 1 and September 30. Cotton raised just under $500,000 in the same period. Jeff Wadlin , the Libertarian candidate in the race, reported nearly $51,000 in receipts.
 Shoffner’s impressive fundraising came at the same time that Cotton drastically ramped up his spending to combat Shoffner’s momentum in some August polls . In the third quarter, Cotton reported spending $3.8 million, compared to Shoffner’s $851,000 in expenditures. Wadlin spent just over $48,000.
 The increased spending — bolstered by millions in outside PAC spending that’s funding ads and push polls — seems to have worked for Cotton so far. A Talk Business/Hendrix College poll released last week showed Cotton with a nine-point lead over Shoffner among likely voters.
 Don’t expect to see much of a slowdown in spending between now and Election Day, either. Shoffner ended the third quarter with about $1.4 million cash on hand, while Cotton reported more than four times that amount with $6.8 million available. Wadlin was sitting on about $11,000 going into the final month of the race.
